title: Taking a turn at the public piano
titleZh: 公共鋼琴輪流使用公告
passage:
CEDAR COURT MUSIC CORNER
Notice beside the public piano

Anyone may play. Put one wooden token in the tray next to the bench when you take a turn. The tokens show how many times the piano is used, not how many people are in the room. Do not add a second token if a friend joins you for a duet during the same turn.

A turn is up to fifteen minutes while anyone is waiting. The wall clock shows the time; it does not mark the start of a turn. Please note the time when you first sit down, not when you finish getting your music ready.

On the first Thursday of each month the neighbors hold a listening hour at four. The hour is for people to listen to a scheduled player. Ordinary turns must stop before then, even if no one is waiting. Visitors who arrive before four may keep a seat, but a seat does not reserve a piano turn for later.
passageZh:
雪松中庭音樂角
公共鋼琴旁公告

任何人都能彈琴。輪到你時，在琴椅旁托盤裡放一枚木牌。木牌計算的是鋼琴使用次數，不是房間內的人數。同一次輪到你時，若朋友加入合奏，不要多放一枚。

有人等候時，每次最多十五分鐘。牆上的鐘顯示現在時間，不會標記每次輪彈的開始時間。請記下剛坐下的時間，不是備好樂譜的時間。

每個月第一個星期四下午四點，鄰居們會舉辦聆聽時段，讓大家聽已排定的人演奏。即使沒人排隊，一般輪彈也要在四點前停止。四點前到場的訪客可留座，但座位不能用來預約之後的彈琴時段。
